pages.title: Animal Drops
pages.text: Firstworks can replace leather with Raw Hide and add bones to tagged animals. Species profiles and exclusion tags let packs choose eligible animals and quantities. Looting and profiles affect yields; not every creature necessarily supplies hides.

pages.title: Fleece and Tools
pages.text: Sheep drops and shearing retain fleece colour. Shears gather Raw Fleece; a primitive knife can also shear a wool-bearing sheep for one fleece, using durability. Bones become tools or Bone Meal. Wash fleece before bedding; tan hides before using them as Leather.

pages.title: Pack Rules
pages.text: Unexpected drops may come from changed server settings, entity tags, or material profiles. Firstworks respects configured exclusions. Tanning is a multi-stage chain, and Raw Hide is not interchangeable with finished Leather.
